title: Portuguese reach the islands
description: Sailors in the Portuguese service, among them António de Noli and Diogo Gomes, find the uninhabited archipelago.

title: Ribeira Grande founded
description: The first permanent European settlement in the tropics is founded on Santiago and grows rich on the slave and sugar trades.

title: Drake raids the islands
description: Francis Drake's expedition sacks and burns the settlements of Santiago at the start of its raid on Spain's Atlantic trade.

title: Praia becomes the capital
description: The seat of government moves from the declining Ribeira Grande to the better-defended plateau of Praia.

title: Submarine cable reaches Cape Verde
description: A telegraph cable links the islands to Madeira and Brazil, and Mindelo's coaling station makes São Vicente a busy Atlantic port.

title: Cape Verde becomes an overseas province
description: Portugal reclassifies the colony as an overseas province amid growing criticism of its rule in Africa.

title: Independence from Portugal
description: The islands become independent under Aristides Pereira's PAIGC government after negotiations in Lisbon.

title: PAICV breaks away
description: After the coup in Guinea-Bissau breaks the union project, Cape Verde's wing of the PAIGC becomes a separate party, the PAICV.

title: Monteiro wins the presidency
description: António Mascarenhas Monteiro defeats Aristides Pereira in free elections, ending sixteen years of one-party PAICV rule.

title: Pires elected president
description: Pedro Pires of the PAICV wins by a handful of votes after a run-off, and the result is accepted.

title: Cape Verde joins the WTO
description: The island state, which had just left the ranks of the least developed countries, becomes a member of the World Trade Organization.

title: Cidade Velha named World Heritage
description: UNESCO inscribes the old town and its fortress as a World Heritage Site.

title: Fonseca elected president
description: Jorge Carlos Fonseca wins the run-off, while the PAICV keeps the government and most municipalities.

title: Fogo eruption
description: A fissure eruption on Fogo buries two villages in lava and forces the evacuation of the caldera.

title: MpD wins the general election
description: The opposition Movement for Democracy wins a majority and Ulisses Correia e Silva becomes prime minister.
